lines.speaker: Khoa (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Hi Thảo, do you have ten minutes? I want to go through my comments on your pull request.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Developer)
lines.text: Sure, Khoa. I saw you left quite a few comments. Is it that bad?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Not at all. The feature works well. Most comments are small suggestions about naming and structure.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Developer)
lines.text: OK. What is the most important one?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Senior Developer)
lines.text: You hardcoded the timeout value. It should come from the config file, so we can change it without a new release.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Developer)
lines.text: Good point. I'll move it to the config. What about the payment function?

lines.speaker: Khoa (Senior Developer)
lines.text: It has too many nested conditions. Could you use early returns? It will be much easier to read.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Developer)
lines.text: Yes, I can do that. By the way, I think the second null check in your comment is actually needed.

lines.speaker: Khoa (Senior Developer)
lines.text: Oh, you're right. The value can be empty when the user logs out. Nice catch, I'll remove that comment.

lines.speaker: Thảo (Developer)
lines.text: Thanks. I'll push the changes this afternoon and ask you to review again.
